text: 【潘功胜：全球失衡不能依靠汇率调节】10月15日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜在出席二十国集团（G20）财长和央行行长会议时表示，关于全球失衡，各方应有更全面的分析视角。不能只看经常账户，也要关注金融渠道，特别是随着全球金融一体化加深，应更加重视资本流动等金融因素对失衡的影响。
text_en: [Pan Gongsheng: Global imbalances cannot be adjusted through exchange rates] On October 15, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng said while attending the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting that on global imbalances, all parties should adopt a more comprehensive analytical perspective. It is not enough to look only at the current account; attention should also be paid to financial channels. In particular, as global financial integration deepens, greater attention should be given to the impact of financial factors such as capital flows on imbalances.
